My pet Sol has always been very picky about pet shops, even though she loves water, it was always a drama to wash her.
When I discovered Dog Douche more than 2 years ago and Sol went in without any major problems, I knew that was the place.
Today Sol has an annual plan and doesn't bathe anywhere else; the staff treat her with all the love and care. We've already used their services for bathing, sanitary trims, moisturizing, grooming, and dog taxi.
And I continue to recommend them to everyone! I highly recommend them!!!!
